findings.claim: The change marks the source-bound receipt task complete without adding the required receipt under the specified evidence path.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 5 requires: "Save a source-bound receipt under `.kbd-orchestrator/phases/production-readiness-integration/evidence/pri-c010-type-watch/`; run applicable local quality checks..." The diff contains no added or modified file under `.kbd-orchestrator/phases/production-readiness-integration/evidence/pri-c010-type-watch/`, while `tasks.md` checks item 5 as complete.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the current source-bound receipt file(s) under `.kbd-orchestrator/phases/production-readiness-integration/evidence/pri-c010-type-watch/` or leave task 5 unchecked until the receipt is committed/included in the packet.

findings.claim: The deployment profile test script commits a hardcoded entity watch checkpoint signing key.
findings.evidence: Constraint S1 says: "No hardcoded secrets (API keys, tokens, signing secrets) in any committed file. Secrets come from env / a secret manager; validated present at startup." The diff adds `export FRF_ENTITY_WATCH_CHECKPOINT_KEY=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef`, and the new environment/docs describe this value as the HMAC key used to authenticate opaque v2 resume checkpoints.
findings.suggested_fix: Generate a temporary random key inside the test script at runtime, or require the caller to provide `FRF_ENTITY_WATCH_CHECKPOINT_KEY` from the environment without committing a fixed signing key value.
